about_the_game:
The soul of Black Equation, told through music.

This official soundtrack DLC contains 5 original tracks I wrote for Black Equation.

Writing this music was not easy for me. It was my first experience composing a full soundtrack, and it came during a very difficult period of my life. Each track was written slowly, carefully, often through doubt, exhaustion, and silence — but also through a genuine need to express something I couldn’t say in words alone.

The soundtrack is deeply inspired by the world of the game and reflects themes of love, loss, intimacy, inner conflict, and quiet transcendence. Some pieces are fragile and haunting, others more cinematic and expansive — all of them are connected to the emotional core of Black Equation.

I am deeply grateful to everyone who supported me during this process and helped bring these songs into being.

All tracks are included in OGG and WAV formats and can be accessed through your Steam Music library.

Includes:

  • 5 original tracks composed for Black Equation

  • Vocal and ambient pieces

  • Steam-integrated playback via the Music tab
